# `base/batch-action-bar`

A multi-select produces a selection whose actions must appear without shifting the list.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A multi-select produces a selection whose actions must appear without shifting the list.
- **Avoid when:** Actions apply to one row, or the surface is a page-level form.
- **Consider instead:** `base/action-menu`, `base/forms`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { BatchActionBar } from "themelia-ui/base/batch-action-bar"
import "themelia-ui/base/batch-action-bar.css"
```

### `BatchActionBarPlacement`

### `BatchActionBarProps`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `selectedCount` | yes | `number` | The bar renders nothing at zero, so a caller can mount it unconditionally. |
| `totalCount` | no | `number` | Optional denominator for the summary. Omit when the total is unknown or unbounded. |
| `onClear` | no | `() => void` | Omit to render no clear control — a selection the user cannot drop needs a reason. |
| `placement` | no | `BatchActionBarPlacement` | `floating` docks to the bottom centre of the viewport; `inline` sits in flow. |
| `strings` | no | `StringsProp<BatchActionBarStrings>` |  |
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | The bulk actions. Buttons, a menu, whatever the surface needs. |
| `className` | no | `string` |  |

### `BatchActionBarStrings`

Kind: interface.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `summary` | yes | `(selected: number, total?: number) => string` | The selection summary ("3 of 250 selected"), a function because sentence shape varies by language. |
| `clear` | yes | `string` | The control that drops the selection. |
| `label` | yes | `string` | Names the bar for assistive technology. |

### Floating

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
import { useState } from "react"

import { BatchActionBar } from "themelia-ui/base/batch-action-bar"
import { Button } from "themelia-ui/base/buttons"
import { Stack } from "themelia-ui/base/structure"
import { Text } from "themelia-ui/base/typography"

/*
 * `transform` makes the demo box the containing block for the fixed bar. The same applies
 * in an app: inside a transformed or `contain: paint` ancestor, the bar docks to that box.
 */
const DEMO_BOX: React.CSSProperties = {
	position: "relative",
	transform: "translate(0)",
	minHeight: "12rem",
	width: "100%",
	padding: "var(--space-lg)",
	border: "var(--border-width) dashed var(--border)",
	borderRadius: "var(--radius)",
}

export default function Floating() {
	const [selected, setSelected] = useState(3)

	return (
		<Stack gap="md" style={{ width: "100%" }}>
			<Stack direction="horizontal" gap="sm" align="center">
				<Button type="button" tone="neutral" buttonStyle="outline" onClick={() => setSelected((n) => n + 1)}>
					Select one more
				</Button>
				<Text size="sm" type="secondary">
					The bar unmounts at zero, so it can be rendered unconditionally.
				</Text>
			</Stack>
			<div style={DEMO_BOX}>
				<Text size="sm" type="secondary">
					The bar below is contained to this box for the demo. In an app it docks to the viewport.
				</Text>
				<BatchActionBar selectedCount={selected} totalCount={250} onClear={() => setSelected(0)}>
					<Button type="button" tone="neutral" buttonStyle="ghost">
						Export
					</Button>
					<Button type="button" tone="destructive" buttonStyle="ghost">
						Delete
					</Button>
				</BatchActionBar>
			</div>
		</Stack>
	)
}
```

### Inline

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
import { BatchActionBar } from "themelia-ui/base/batch-action-bar"
import { Button } from "themelia-ui/base/buttons"

export default function Inline() {
	return (
		<BatchActionBar
			placement="inline"
			selectedCount={12}
			onClear={() => undefined}
			strings={{ label: "Inline batch actions example" }}
		>
			<Button type="button" tone="neutral" buttonStyle="ghost">
				Assign
			</Button>
		</BatchActionBar>
	)
}
```
